reason: Close the Product Experience runtime-reachability gap using Element Web's own mature runtime module mechanism. The Yance module already implements @element-hq/element-web-module-api and is copied into the pinned Element workspace, but the pinned Element Docker image only serves modules that exist in /modules at runtime. Authorize one minimal upstream Dockerfile patch that builds the existing Yance module inside the pinned Element workspace and copies only its package.json and lib output into /modules/yance, allowing Element's existing 18-load-element-modules.sh, SdkConfig modules list, ModuleLoader dynamic import, and nginx /modules alias to remain the sole module loading authority. Do not revive the deprecated build_config/module_system path and do not add a Yance module loader.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact repository-relative normalized paths, discard invalid paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

observedCausalRed.contract: Product module is delivered through Element official runtime module directory
observedCausalRed.rootCause: Pinned Element's new ModuleLoader only imports URLs from SdkConfig.modules. Its Docker entrypoint populates that list from /modules and nginx serves /modules, but Yance currently only copies source into the Element build workspace; no built Yance module is present under /modules in the final Element image.

requiredBehavior: Build the already-copied modules/yance workspace package using the pinned Element workspace dependency graph.
Copy only modules/yance/package.json and modules/yance/lib into /modules/yance in the final Element nginx image.
Rely on Element's existing 18-load-element-modules.sh to append /modules/yance/lib/index.js to config.json modules.
Rely on Element's existing nginx /modules alias to serve the module.
Rely on Element's existing ModuleLoader and SdkConfig modules list to dynamically import and start the module.
forbiddenBehavior: Do not use apps/web/build_config.yaml or the deprecated @matrix-org/react-sdk-module-api module system.
Do not add a Yance-owned module loader or dynamic import framework.
Do not vendor a second React copy into the Yance module.
Do not widen the patch beyond apps/web/Dockerfile.
